node-1.label: A 53-year-old woman has had a lump on the posterior aspect of the right knee joint for 3 years, with pain and discomfort when walking or standing with the knee extended

node-2.label: The patient is a 53-year-old woman with no underlying diseases and a 3-year history of a lump on the posterior aspect of the right knee joint

node-3.label: The lump is growing at the posterior aspect of the right knee joint and causes pain and discomfort during walking or standing with the knee joint extended

node-4.label: Physical examination: right knee range of motion 10-130°, no internal swelling of the knee joint, no tenderness of medial or lateral joint line, normal Lachman test, normal valgus and varus stress tests, and a 3×3 cm palpable lump at the posterior aspect of the right knee joint
